metadata.senateDatasetCitation: MIT Election Data and Science Lab, U.S. Senate statewide 1976-2024, Harvard Dataverse, accessed 2026-10-04.
metadata.scopeNote: Latest completed election, including runoffs, for each 2026 contest. House history is keyed by the same district number; districts redrawn since 2024 may have different boundaries. Historical county-level subtotals are not included.
